sentences.text:
Kondu Ravinder vs The State Of Telangana on 14 August, 2024
 The Honourable Smt. Justice K. Sujana
 Criminal Petition No.9374 of 2024
Order:

entities.text: Kondu Ravinder vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS') by the petitioner/accused No.1 seeking to quash the proceedings against him in Crime No.208 of 2024 on the file of Jammikunta Town Police Station, Karimnagar, registered for the alleged offences punishable under Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

2. Heard Sri Seshagiri Rao Yalamanchili, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Arun Kumar Doddla, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for respondent No.1 - State.
3. Without going into the merits of the case, since the punishment prescribed for the offences alleged against the petitioner is less than seven (07) years, this Court deems it appropriate to direct the petitioner to appear before the Investigating Officer on or before 28.08.2024 between 11:00 a.m.
and 05:00 p.m. and in turn, the Investigating Officer is directed to follow the procedure laid down under section 41-A of Criminal Procedure Code (presently Section 35(3) of the BNSS) and also the guidelines formulated by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1 scrupulously.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However, the petitioner shall submit his defense and co-operate with the Investigating Officer as and when required by furnishing information and produce all relevant documents/material required for the purpose of the investigation and the Investigating Officer shall consider the same before filing appropriate report before the learned Magistrate concerned.
4. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall also stand closed.
